name: ScholarLMS
description_en:
ScholarLMS is a hosted learning platform for course creation, training delivery, assessment and course selling. It combines learner administration, reporting and human support for creators, training providers and organizations.

Its pricing distinguishes active, registered and concurrent learners. These counts answer different capacity questions, and an open-source foundation does not mean the hosted service has no subscription cost.
description_zh:
ScholarLMS 是托管学习平台，支持创课、培训交付、考核和课程销售，并为创作者、培训方和组织提供学员管理、报告及人工支持。

价格区分活跃、登记和并发学员，三者对应不同容量问题。采用开源基础也不意味着托管服务无需订阅费。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans distinguish active, registered and concurrent learner limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐区分活跃、登记及并发学员限制。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Courses, live learning and commercial delivery
sections.title_zh: 课程、实时学习与商业交付
sections.en: The homepage describes building courses, running live sessions, managing enrollment and assessments, reporting and ecommerce. The plan cards place SCORM lessons and classroom recording under Standard, SSO/custom roles/LTI under Advanced, and learning plans under Premium. Check those boundaries before importing content or planning an institutional integration.
sections.zh: 首页介绍创课、实时课程、选课和考核管理、报告及电商。套餐卡把 SCORM 课程和课堂录制列在 Standard，SSO、自定义角色和 LTI 列在 Advanced，学习计划列在 Premium。导入内容或规划机构集成前，需检查这些边界。

sections.title_en: Example: certify a monthly customer cohort
sections.title_zh: 示例：为每月客户组认证
sections.en: Create a short course and quiz, manually enroll a pilot group and verify learner access and completion evidence. If selling it, test purchase-to-enrollment and a failed order separately. A monthly cohort of registered accounts is not necessarily the same number of billable active learners; logins, enrollment and concurrency need distinct checks. No course or checkout was executed here.
sections.zh: 创建短课和测验，手动登记试点组，核对访问及完成证据。若销售课程，需分别检查购买到选课和订单失败。每月登记账户数不一定等于计费活跃学员数，登录、选课和并发应分别检查。本文未运行课程或结账。

sections.en: The pricing page defines an active learner as someone who logs in during a calendar month and is enrolled in a course; the count resets monthly. Basic lists 50 active learners, 500 registered learners, 20 courses and two administrators. Its displayed amount is $49/month billed yearly, with some toggle values unrendered. A Starter comparison column lists 25 active and 50 registered learners at $0. Advanced course limits conflict between its card and table, so verify the chosen allowance and billing cadence instead of assuming all rows agree.
sections.zh: 定价页把活跃学员定义为一个自然月内登录且已选课的人，每月重置。Basic 列 50 活跃学员、500 登记学员、20 课程及两名管理员，显示每月 49 美元、按年结算，部分切换金额未渲染。Starter 对照列写 25 活跃、50 登记学员及零元。Advanced 课程上限在卡片和表格间有冲突，因此需确认所选额度及周期，不能假定所有行一致。

sections.en: Start with a representative course, roles and a completion rule. Inspect reports after a failed attempt and a resumed session, and estimate video upload needs separately from storage. ScholarLMS may fit a managed course operation; it does not guarantee instructional outcomes or unrestricted rights to every extension. Exact service licensing, fair-use terms, restoration and custom integration behavior remain unverified.
sections.zh: 从代表性课程、角色和完成规则开始，在失败及恢复会话后检查报告，并把视频上传需求与存储分开估计。它可能适合托管课程运营，但不保证教学成果或所有扩展的无限权利。服务许可、公平使用、恢复及自定义集成行为仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Confirm current billing toggle amounts, Advanced course cap, fair-use limits, source/extension licenses and backup recovery.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认计费切换金额、Advanced 课程上限、公平使用限制、源码扩展许可及备份恢复。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
